notes: Operational admission signal, not research evidence. An approved-unrun contract is a specification with status approved, no run entry under experiments/<id>/runs/ and no evidence record citing it. Contracts approved on or after the cutoff may not exceed the per-goal cap at the time of approval and must carry a first_measurement block {command, max_seconds, null_object} in the specification. Contracts approved before the cutoff are reported, never blocked. Expiry returns an overdue approved-unrun contract to draft and is a Coordinator action logged by a decision record. See docs/harness-funnel.md.
